text: Which condensate pipelines are within 1 kilometer of wells classified as 'gas shows'?

text: I need wells that have well logs and an entry date after 1987, within 2 kilometers of injection pipelines whose from facility is not 'JOHAN SVERDRUP RP'.

where: PipelinesType = cast(3 as SMALLINT) and (from_facility <> 'JOHAN SVERDRUP RP')

source_text: Find wells where (the feature has well logs) and (entry date after 1987). The returned wells must be within 2 kilometers of injection pipelines where from facility is not 'JOHAN SVERDRUP RP'.

text: Give me every well classified as 'oil/condensate' that has NPD papers.

where: content_type = cast(15 as SMALLINT) and (npd_papers = cast(1 as SMALLINT))
